name: Burst Fracture of the Spine
definition: Axial-load vertebral fracture involving anterior and middle columns with possible retropulsion into the spinal canal.

investigations.principle: CT is central for fracture morphology; MRI evaluates neural elements and ligament injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Operative versus nonoperative care is individualized.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna phenotype may be documented only after modern fracture classification.

patientEducation.summary: Axial-load vertebral fracture involving anterior and middle columns with possible retropulsion into the spinal canal.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
